key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Sudden, often triggered by stress or anxiety. LOCATION: Diffuse chest. DURATION: Minutes to hours. CHARACTER: Dyspnea, chest tightness, 'can't get enough air'. AGGRAVATING: Stress, anxiety, panic. RELIEVING: Breathing exercises, paper bag breathing, reassurance. TIMING: Episodic, often during stress. SEVERITY: Moderate (5-7/10). ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: Paresthesias, dizziness, lightheadedness, chest tightness, palpitations, anxiety. KEY POSITIVES: Anxiety, stress, paresthesias, dizziness. KEY NEGATIVES: No fever, no chest pain (unless secondary), no wheezing.
